body: No connection between scenes. Total waste of time. The story is baseless and illogical. I ended up fast forwarding and going to the end. I'm not sure how this movie got such a high rating. IMDb should scrutinize and provide authentic reviews. Or provide critic review and user review seperately. Thank you.

Bakasura Restaurant is a refreshing and highly entertaining film that blends comedy, mystery, and quirky horror in a very engaging way. The concept feels unique, the storytelling keeps the curiosity alive, and the fun chaotic moments make the movie enjoyable throughout. The performances add great charm, and the film carries a distinct energy that makes it stand out. It's creative, entertaining, and delivers a different experience that keeps the audience hooked. Definitely a memorable one-time watch, and for its originality and entertainment value.

I was really shocked while watching this movie because I had read the book which showed in the movie.

I Read that Book In my childhood. The Bakasura team has clearly done very good research, and it reflects on screen.

The emotional scenes are well-made and connect with the audience. The comedy is definitely one of the best parts of the movie-it keeps the flow light and entertaining.

Music and songs are okay, not extraordinary but decent. Direction is good, and overall it feels like a feel-good movie.

I promise you will enjoy it. Definitely waiting for the second part.

A supposedly horror-comedy-emotional-drama turned out to be exactly as intended but with no genuine bit of each.

Horror. No horror and the supposedly horror tone turned out to be the comedy.

Comedy. Bad. Very bad Comedy. Cringed the most.

Emotions and the Drama didn't workout with a very loud melodramatic music and cliches.

Performances. Execution was so bad that it made performances look bad in most of the scenes.

Overall, a very underwhelming watch.

I would want to give negative stars but still there is no feature for it. And people who have given 10 should be for sure paid promotions. I don't even understand for how many times you will repeat the scene. If the ghost eats food fine. Should you be showing it 100 times and irritate the audience and not sure why there is a song inside mosque. It's totally a useless movie. I feel bad for the producer.
